decisions.reason: After two years without website visibility, this classic handle line looks more replaceable within the mature core assortment and is a plausible candidate for portfolio simplification.
A multi-model lever-handle family still supports specification breadth for architects and projects, so despite lower visibility it remains worth retaining.
As a single door-handle design close to many existing offers and not observed for two years, it is the most likely to be discontinued to free resources for stronger system lines and new development.
This handle family likely still contributes useful range depth across design and budget levels, which fits the firm's broad-market strategy.

The electronic access system remains closely aligned with the firm's move toward integrated digital building solutions, so management would normally continue it unless it is replaced by a successor platform.
